```{r}
# Load data
data(PlantGrowth)

# Get column names and datatypes
str(PlantGrowth)
```

## Plot

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(PlantGrowth, aes(group, weight)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
k <- 3
n <- length(PlantGrowth$weight)
n - k
```

```{r}
model <- lm(weight ~ group, data = PlantGrowth)
anova(model)
```
